name: ModelDB_list_models
description: List all computational neuroscience model IDs from ModelDB, optionally filtered by simulation environment. ModelDB is a curated repository of published computational neuroscience models. Returns an array of model IDs that can be used with ModelDB_get_model for full details. Filter by modeling application name (e.g., 'NEURON', 'GENESIS', 'Python', 'MATLAB', 'Brian'). Without a filter, returns all model IDs (1000+). Use this to discover models for a specific simulator or to get an overview of available models.

modeling_application.description: Filter by simulation environment name. Case-sensitive. Common values: 'NEURON', 'GENESIS', 'Python', 'MATLAB', 'Brian', 'NEST', 'XPP', 'C or C++'. Omit to get all models.

oneOf.description: Array of model IDs (integers). Use ModelDB_get_model to get full details for any ID.

name: ModelDB_get_model
description: Get detailed information about a specific computational neuroscience model from ModelDB by its numeric ID. Returns the model name, description (notes), neuron types, ion currents, model type, model concepts, modeling application (simulator), associated papers with citations, genes, receptors, transmitters, brain region, and creation/version dates. ModelDB is a curated repository of published computational neuroscience models hosted by Yale/SenseLab. Use model IDs from ModelDB_list_models or from the ModelDB website (e.g., model 3263 is CA3 Pyramidal Neuron by Migliore et al 1995).

model_id.description: Numeric model ID from ModelDB. Examples: 3263 (CA3 pyramidal neuron), 2487 (Purkinje cell), 279 (squid axon), 87284 (cerebellar granule cell). Find IDs using ModelDB_list_models.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field, e.g. 25. Every attribute block carries one alongside its value; it identifies the field in ModelDB's own schema, not the model.
ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field, e.g. 25. Every attribute block carries one alongside its value; it identifies the field in ModelDB's own schema, not the model.

model_type.description: Type of model (e.g., Neuron or other electrically excitable cell)

model_concept.description: Model concepts (e.g., Bursting, Detailed Neuronal Models)

class_id.description: Numeric id of the ModelDB class the entry belongs to, e.g. 19. The key behind the model's category.

gitrepo.description: True when the model's source is kept in a git repository rather than only as a ModelDB archive.

has_modelview.description: Whether a ModelView structural analysis exists for the model, as a {'value', 'attr_id'} pair.

hide_autolaunch_button.description: Whether ModelDB suppresses the one-click launch button for this model, as a {'value', 'attr_id'} pair. Effectively says the model cannot be run in the browser.

implemented_by.description: Who implemented the model, as ModelDB's {'value', 'attr_id'} pair - the credit for the code as distinct from the paper's authors.

modelviews.description: The ModelView analyses available, under 'all' and 'default'. Which precomputed views of the model's structure can be opened.

runprotocols.description: How to run the model, as a {'value', 'attr_id'} pair. The instructions needed to reproduce the published figures; without them the downloaded archive is just files.

simPFid.description: The model's SimPlatform id, as a {'value', 'attr_id'} pair.

ver_number.description: Version number of the model entry, e.g. 14. ModelDB entries are revised, and nothing else here says which revision was fetched.

name: ModelDB_get_paper
description: Get details of a scientific paper referenced in ModelDB by its paper ID. Returns the paper title, full citation name, references, and associated models. Papers in ModelDB are linked to computational neuroscience models and represent the publications describing those models. Use paper IDs found in ModelDB_get_model results (in the model_paper field). Example: paper 4307 is 'Migliore et al 1995' describing CA3 hippocampal neuron simulations.

paper_id.description: Numeric paper ID from ModelDB. Examples: 4307 (Migliore et al 1995), 3860 (Hodgkin-Huxley classic). Find IDs from model_paper field in ModelDB_get_model results.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for the title field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

url.description: API URL for the paper record, e.g. 'https://modeldb.science/api/v1/papers/4307'.

authors.description: The paper's authors, each with a ModelDB object_id and name, e.g. 'Migliore M'. The citation's author list. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

class_id.description: Numeric id of the ModelDB class the record belongs to, e.g. 42.

doi.description: DOI of the paper, e.g. '10.1152/jn.1995.73.3.1157'. The only stable citation link here. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

value_lower.description: The DOI lower-cased, which ModelDB stores alongside the DOI itself for case-insensitive matching. DOIs are case-insensitive by specification but are usually printed mixed-case, so a lookup against `value` can miss where one against this succeeds.

first_page.description: First page, e.g. '1157'. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

journal.description: Journal name, e.g. 'Journal of neurophysiology'. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

last_page.description: Last page, abbreviated to the digits that change - measured '68' for a paper running from first_page 1157, i.e. 1168. It is NOT a page number on its own. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

missing_references.description: ModelDB's curation note on whether the paper's references have been entered, e.g. 'all done'. Says whether an empty reference list means none exist or none have been curated yet. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

month.description: Publication month as an abbreviation, e.g. 'Mar'. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

pubmed_id.description: PubMed id, e.g. '7608762'. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

ver_date.description: When that version was created, e.g. '2023-05-08T16:49:10.970343'.

ver_number.description: Version of the paper record, e.g. 4.

volume.description: Volume, e.g. '73'. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

year.description: Publication year, e.g. '1995'. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

name: ModelDB_list_celltypes
description: List all neuron/cell type IDs available in ModelDB. Returns an array of cell type IDs that can be used with ModelDB_get_celltype for full details including name and morphology. ModelDB categorizes computational models by the neuron types they simulate, such as hippocampal pyramidal cells, Purkinje cells, cortical interneurons, etc. This is useful for finding what cell types have computational models available.

oneOf.description: Array of cell type IDs (strings). Use ModelDB_get_celltype for details.

name: ModelDB_get_celltype
description: Get details about a specific neuron/cell type from ModelDB by its cell type ID. Returns the cell type name (e.g., 'Hippocampus CA3 pyramidal GLU cell', 'Cerebellum Purkinje GABA cell'), creation date, and version info. Cell type IDs can be obtained from ModelDB_list_celltypes or from the neurons field of ModelDB_get_model results. This is useful for understanding what neuron types are modeled in computational neuroscience.

celltype_id.description: Cell type ID from ModelDB. Examples: '259' (Hippocampus CA3 pyramidal GLU cell), '258' (Hippocampus CA1 pyramidal GLU cell), '263' (Cerebellum Purkinje GABA cell). Find IDs using ModelDB_list_celltypes.

Can_Form_type.description: Which canonical forms the cell type can take, e.g. 'Canonical form 3'. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

Picture.description: The illustration attached to the cell type, with its file name, extension and mime type. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

Picture_from.description: Where that illustration came from, e.g. 'GM Shepherd, Synaptic Organization of the Brain, New York: ...'. The attribution a reuse would need. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

coordinates_2d.description: The cell type's position in ModelDB's 2-D layout, e.g. '84,87'. A display coordinate, not anatomy. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

description.description: Prose description of the cell type, e.g. 'The principal neuron of region CA3 of the hippocampus...'. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

neuroelectro.description: The NeuroElectro id, e.g. '89'. The route to measured electrophysiological properties for this cell type. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

neurolex.description: The NeuroLex identifier for the cell type, e.g. 'Hippocampus_CA3_pyramidal_cell'. The join to the wider neuroanatomy vocabularies. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

neuron_category.description: Whether it is a 'principal' neuron or an interneuron - the distinction that decides its role in a circuit. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

neurontype.description: The neuron type, e.g. 'Pyramidal', as an object list with ModelDB object ids. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

organism.description: The organism the cell type belongs to, e.g. 'Vertebrates'. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

rotation.description: Display rotation for that layout, e.g. 45. Also presentation, not biology. ModelDB wraps it as {'value', 'attr_id'}, so the content is one level in under 'value'.

attr_id.description: ModelDB's internal attribute id for this field; it identifies the field in ModelDB's schema, not the record.

ver_number.description: Version of the cell-type record, e.g. 13.
